import cv2,numpy as np
c=cv2.VideoCapture('example_video.mp4')
fs=[]
while True:
  r,f=c.read()
  if not r: break
  fs.append(f)
bg=cv2.GaussianBlur(fs[0],(5,5),0).astype(np.float32)
out=[]
for i in [0,20,40,53,58,62,70,90]:
  f=cv2.GaussianBlur(fs[i],(5,5),0).astype(np.float32)
  d=np.abs(f-bg).max(2)
  print(i,np.percentile(d,[50,90,99]))
  m=(d>40).astype(np.uint8)*255
  out.append(cv2.resize(m,(480,270)))
cv2.imwrite('dbg/mask.jpg',np.vstack([np.hstack(out[:4]),np.hstack(out[4:])]))
"
